evidence.excerpt: Across resting-state benchmarks, FlatClip serves as a competitive middle-ground representation, outperforming ROI-level baselines on HCP and ADNI tasks while remaining weaker on PPMI and below the strongest voxel-level models overall.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Motivated by evidence that macroscale brain activity is strongly constrained by brain geometry, we introduce FlatClip, a frozen-encoder surface-level baseline that renders cortical activity as geometry-aware flatmap sequences and reuses a frozen SigLIP2 image encoder with only a lightweight downstream probe.
